title: Ekpyrotic and cyclic universe
example_questions: What happened before the Big Bang?
summary: Instead of inflation, the early universe went through a slow contracting phase that smoothed it out. The Big Bang was a bounce, pictured in the original version as the collision of two branes in a higher dimension. In the cyclic version, this repeats: expansion, contraction, bounce.
support_note: The main alternative to inflation; a minority of cosmologists but actively studied.
what_happens: The universe slowly contracts and smooths out
In the cyclic version the process repeats
objections: The bounce physics is not fully worked out

sources.title: The Ekpyrotic Universe: Colliding Branes and the Origin of the Hot Big Bang
sources.authors: J. Khoury, B. A. Ovrut, P. J. Steinhardt, N. Turok

sources.title: A cyclic model of the universe
